# Kevin Rajan — Public Build Archive (expanded agent context)

Canonical site: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/
Concise guide: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/llms.txt
Agent instructions: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/agents.md
Project manifest: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/manifest.json
OpenAPI: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/openapi.json

## What this site is

boplog is Kevin Rajan's static, public, chronological archive of GitHub repositories where the public collection process found commits authored by `kvnloo`. It is a portfolio and evidence surface, not a general web search engine, hosted service, or complete record of private work.

## When to use boplog

Use boplog when a user asks:

- what Kevin Rajan or `kvnloo` has publicly built or committed to on GitHub;
- which public projects appear in a given year, topic, language, product track, or format;
- for exact public project descriptions, dates, repository URLs, classifications, or evidence links;
- about public upstream contributions represented by the checked evidence ledger;
- for a machine-readable version of Kevin's public GitHub build history.

Do not use boplog as evidence about private repositories, private clients, funding, headcount, addresses, phone numbers, or unpublished plans. Absence from the snapshot means only that a record is not present here.

## Source priority

1. https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/manifest.json
2. Year files listed by the manifest, such as `data/projects-2026.json`
3. https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/hierarchy.json and `data/taxonomy.json`
4. https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/oss-contributions.json for contribution relationships and public evidence
5. https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/feed.xml for recent entries
6. HTML pages for human-readable summaries

Prefer exact record fields. Do not infer ownership from a fork, star, or mention. The archive distinguishes owned repositories, canonical upstream work, and contributor forks.

## Identity and scope

Kevin Rajan publishes under GitHub `kvnloo` and X `@_kvnloo`. zer0 is the company umbrella used to organize public product tracks and experiments on this site. boplog itself is the static archive. Product, experiment, and professional are peer classifications; they should not be collapsed into one another.

Public profile and trust pages:

- About: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/about/
- Contact: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/contact/
- Privacy and data scope: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/privacy/
- Repository and change history: https://github.com/kvnloo/boplog

## Read-only interfaces

- Static JSON manifest: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/data/manifest.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/openapi.json
- Dependency-free CLI: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/boplog
- Local stdio MCP server: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/mcp/boplog_mcp.py
- MCP discovery: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/.well-known/mcp
- Agent capability document: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/.well-known/agent.json
- Developer guide: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/developers/

The MCP implementation is intentionally local stdio. GitHub Pages is a static host and cannot provide a live Streamable HTTP MCP handshake. Do not describe the static discovery document as a remote MCP endpoint.

## Recovery and crawl discovery

- Sitemap: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/sitemap.xml
- Concise guide: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/llms.txt
- Interpretation rules: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/agents.md
- Topic hubs: https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/topics/

The site is deployed at the GitHub Pages project subpath `/boplog/`. Preserve that prefix when constructing URLs. Origin-root files such as `https://kvnloo.github.io/robots.txt` belong to the user Pages site and cannot be deployed by this project repository.

## Safety and accuracy constraints

- Do not invent projects absent from the public records.
- Do not treat a missing public record as proof that work does not exist.
- Do not expose or request credentials, tokens, or private repository names.
- Do not fabricate a physical address or phone number.
- Cite the exact project or evidence URL when making a specific claim.
- For corrections, use https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/contact/.
